messages:
maya: Heads up — search campaign pacing is off. Spent ~65% of daily budget in first 6 hours and CTR is dropping. anyone seeing the same in GA?
josh: yep saw the spike. CPC up 18% this morning. probably competition on branded keywords.
lina: looking at query report now. a few non-converting high-volume queries popped up. will scrub neg keywords.
maya: timeline? can we throttle mid-day to smooth spend? want to avoid exhausting budget before webinar promo at 3pm.
victor: suggest applying a pacing cap rule: cap daily spend rate to 40% until 2pm, then allow burst to 70% if CPA under target.
paul: finance + forecasting ok with that as long as we don't exceed daily commit. set the cap but add manual override for webinar window.
ads-bot: Automated rule suggestion: "Daytime pacing cap" -> pause retargeting and reduce max CPC by 15% until 14:00 UTC. Preview: will drop expected spend by ~38%.
josh: can you drop max CPC for non-branded queries and keep branded at current bid? branded is still our best conv rate.
lina: yes. quick config I plan to push: ```
{
  "bids": {
    "branded": "+0%",
    "non_branded": "-15%"
  },
  "pacing": {
    "cap_until": "2026-03-21T14:00:00Z",
    "max_daily_rate": 0.4
  }
}
```
maya: perfect. also refresh retarget creative — the current CTA is stale for the webinar. can we test 2 variants? short headline + schedule CTA vs feature-led copy.
victor: agree. run 50/50 for the next 3 hours, then move best performer into the 3pm burst.
paul: please tag spend to campaign:webinar-mar and set UTM so we can attribute leads to the right funnel.
lina: done. utm_source=google&utm_campaign=webinar-mar&utm_content={creative_variant}
josh: monitoring dashboards now. will post a mid-day update at 13:30. if CPA stays > target, we pause retargeting entirely and focus branded search.
maya: thx team. quick checklist: 1) pacing cap rule (lina) 2) bid adjustments (lina/josh) 3) creative A/B (victor) 4) UTMs (lina) 5) finance override ready (paul) 6) mid-day report (josh).
paul: all good on finance. ping me if we need to reallocate reserved budget. :thumbsup:
josh: mid-day report: CTR recovered slightly after bid cuts, spend flattened. will open new thread with exact numbers at 13:30.
maya: awesome — keep me posted. :rocket:
